scripts.build: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist,dist/src,dist/assets,dist/assets/culture,dist/assets/shop | Out-Null; Copy-Item index.html dist/index.html -Force; Copy-Item src/*.js,src/*.css dist/src/ -Force; Copy-Item assets/*.webp dist/assets/ -Force; Copy-Item assets/culture/*.webp dist/assets/culture/ -Force; Copy-Item assets/shop/*.webp dist/assets/shop/ -Force"
